problem_statement: Compute n! (factorial) for non-negative integer n, with 0! = 1 and n! = 1×2×…×n for n ≥ 1.
input_assumptions: Return type is numeric (int) suitable for template test values
boundary_cases: Recursive vs iterative templates must agree on base-case handling for n=0 and n=1
